cards.ex: I gather you're not happy with the proposal?
cards.exUz: Anglashimcha, siz taklifdan mamnun emassiz?
cards.uzDef: Men shunday tushunaman, menimcha shunday bo'lyapti.

cards.ex: She's a star in the making.
cards.exUz: U yaratilish jarayonidagi yulduz.
cards.uzDef: Hali yakunlanmagan, yaratilish yoki rivojlanish jarayonida.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project.
cards.exUz: Keling, loyihani muhokama qilish uchun kelasi hafta aloqaga chiqamiz.

cards.ex: Please keep me in the loop about any changes.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, har qanday o'zgarishlar haqida meni xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Xabardor qilish, biror narsadan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: It stands to reason that prices will increase.
cards.exUz: Narxlar oshishi mantiqan to'g'ri.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqan to'g'ri bo'lgani uchun shunday bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: The event is shaping up nicely.
cards.exUz: Tadbir yaxshi shakllanmoqda.

cards.ex: More often than not, he's late.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha u kech qoladi.

cards.ex: That begs the question of where the money came from.
cards.exUz: Bu pul qayerdan kelgani haqida savol tug'diradi.
cards.uzDef: Savolga javob berishdan qochish, asosiy savolni ochiq qoldirish.

cards.ex: The theory still holds true today.
cards.exUz: Nazariya bugungi kunda hamon rost bo'lib qolmoqda.

cards.ex: Let's see how things play out.
cards.exUz: Keling, voqealar qanday sodir bo'lishini ko'raylik.

cards.ex: It's bound to rain later.
cards.exUz: Keyinroq yomg'ir yog'ishi aniq.

cards.ex: Things are starting to fall into place.
cards.exUz: Hamma narsa o'z o'rniga tusha boshladi.

cards.ex: Her name springs to mind when I think of kindness.
cards.exUz: Mehribonlik haqida o'ylasam, uning ismi yodga keladi.

cards.ex: It's early days, so we don't know what will happen.
cards.exUz: Hali erta, shuning uchun nima bo'lishini bilmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Hali erta, vaqt bor, yakuniy xulosa chiqarishga erta.

cards.ex: As it stands, we can't afford the project.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi holatda, biz loyihani ko'tara olmaymiz.

cards.ex: They don't always see eye to eye.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim ham bir xil fikrda bo'lishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lmoq, bir xil qarashga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I tend to err on the side of caution.
cards.exUz: Men ehtiyot bo'lishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ehtiyotkorlikni oshirmoq, xavfdan saqlanishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: A promotion might be on the cards.
cards.exUz: Lavozim ko'tarilishi rejalarda bor bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The company is gaining ground in the market.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bozorda mavqe orttirmoqda.

cards.ex: The new law is now in effect.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun endi kuchga kirdi.

cards.ex: His performance leaves much to be desired.
cards.exUz: Uning ishlashi yaxshi emas.
cards.term: to leave much to be desired
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi emas, yetarlicha emas, ko'proq yaxshilanishi kerak.

cards.ex: This decision will have a bearing on our future.
cards.exUz: Bu qaror kelajagimizga ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'sir qilmoq, aloqador bo'lmoq, bog'liq bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: As things stand, we're on schedule.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat hozircha shundayki, biz jadval bo'yicha ketyapmiz.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on your progress.
cards.exUz: Meni yutuqlaringizdan xabardor qilib turing.

cards.ex: The situation is difficult, to put it mildly.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat qiyin, yumshoq qilib aytganda.
cards.uzDef: Eng kamida, juda yumshoq qilib aytganda.

cards.ex: I think we're finally getting somewhere with this project.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz nihoyat ushbu loyiha bilan natijaga erishyapmiz.

cards.ex: If the reviews are anything to go by, the movie's terrible.
cards.exUz: Agar sharhlarga qarab baholasak, film dahshatli.
cards.term: to be anything to go by
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga asoslanib baho berish, ko'rsatkich sifatida qabul qilish.

cards.ex: His alibi doesn't hold water.
cards.exUz: Uning alibi asosli emas.
cards.uzDef: Asosli bo'lmoq, ishonarli bo'lmoq, haqiqatga yaqin bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: At this juncture, it's hard to say what will happen.
cards.exUz: Bu bosqichda nima bo'lishini aytish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ayni damda, hozirgi holatda, shu bosqichda.

cards.ex: The new policy is gaining traction.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat ommaboplashmoqda.
